_comment: Each CommonJS module has an eager import with no interop (a side-effect import in `c.js`, a named import in `d.js`) and a deferred import. The eager merge of these imports needs no `__toESM`, but each deferred namespace does. No other import needs `__toESM`: `main.js` reads the log with a named import. The `cjs` variant runs the `cjs` lookup of the helper.
